cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: The student identifies the two phases of TCP congestion control as Slow Start and Congestion Avoidance.
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires naming both Slow Start and Congestion Avoidance
acceptable_variants: Slow start phase and congestion avoidance phase
The two phases are slow start and congestion avoidance
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Slow start (cwnd less than ss_thresh)... Congestion Avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh)

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: The student explains that in the Slow Start phase, the congestion window (cwnd) grows exponentially.
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: any of: cwnd +1 per ACK / doubles each RTT / exponential growth
evidence_facets: cwnd incremented by one per segment acknowledged
acceptable_variants: cwnd grows exponentially in slow start
cwnd doubles every round trip time
cwnd increases by one for every segment acknowledged
slow start causes rapid exponential window growth
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: In the slow start phase, cwnd is incremented by one every time a segment is acknowledged. This results in an exponential growth as cwnd is essentially doubled after each Round Trip Time (RTT).

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: The student explains that in the Congestion Avoidance phase, the congestion window (cwnd) grows linearly.
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: any of: linear growth of cwnd / +1 after all segments ACKed
evidence_facets: increment cwnd by 1 after all sent segments acknowledged
acceptable_variants: cwnd increases linearly in congestion avoidance
window grows slowly by one per window of segments
cwnd increases by one after all segments are acknowledged
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: In the congestion avoidance phase, cwnd is incremented more slowly... they usually grow linearly, e.g. only increment cwnd by 1 after all sent segments have been acknowledged.
